title_en: A Day Spent in Phone Apps
note_en: 一…就… links two actions so that the second follows the first immediately: 手机闹钟一响，我就…刷了几分钟短视频 "as soon as my alarm went off, I...scrolled through short videos." 一 goes right before the first verb and 就 before the second, each after its own subject, where English uses a single conjunction, "as soon as."
